```{r}
selectedTent <- c(
  'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_1', 'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_2', 'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_3', 'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_4', 'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_5',
  'Hypoxia_18hrs_Tent5ba42_1', 'Hypoxia_18hrs_Tent5ba42_2', 'Hypoxia_18hrs_Tent5ba42_3', 'Hypoxia_18hrs_Tent5ba42_4', 'Hypoxia_18hrs_Tent5ba42_5'
)

RexTent <- Rex[, selectedTent]
RinTent <- Rin[, selectedTent]


selectedWT <- c(
  'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_1', 'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_2', 'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_3', 'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_4', 'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_5',
 'Hypoxia_18hrs_WT_1', 'Hypoxia_18hrs_WT_2', 'Hypoxia_18hrs_WT_3', 'Hypoxia_18hrs_WT_4', 'Hypoxia_18hrs_WT_5'
)

RexWT <- Rex[, selectedWT]
RinWT <- Rin[, selectedWT]

selectedNorm <- c(
  'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_1', 'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_2', 'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_3', 'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_4', 'Normoxia_6hpf_WT_5',
  'Normoxia_8hpf_WT_1', 'Normoxia_8hpf_WT_2', 'Normoxia_8hpf_WT_3', 'Normoxia_8hpf_WT_4', 'Normoxia_8hpf_WT_5'
)

RexNorm <- Rex[, selectedNorm]
RinNorm <- Rin[, selectedNorm]


```

```{r}
# Explicit ordering is essential #
condWT_fixed <- factor(
  c("Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_6hpf_WT",
    "Hypoxia_18hrs_WT", "Hypoxia_18hrs_WT", "Hypoxia_18hrs_WT", "Hypoxia_18hrs_WT", "Hypoxia_18hrs_WT"),
  levels = c("Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Hypoxia_18hrs_WT")  
)

condTent_fixed <- factor(
  c("Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_6hpf_WT",
    "Hypoxia_18hrs_Tent5ba42", "Hypoxia_18hrs_Tent5ba42", "Hypoxia_18hrs_Tent5ba42", 
    "Hypoxia_18hrs_Tent5ba42", "Hypoxia_18hrs_Tent5ba42"),
  levels = c("Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Hypoxia_18hrs_Tent5ba42")
)

condNorm_fixed <- factor(
  c("Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_6hpf_WT",
    "Normoxia_8hpf_WT", "Normoxia_8hpf_WT", "Normoxia_8hpf_WT", "Normoxia_8hpf_WT", "Normoxia_8hpf_WT"),
  levels = c("Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_8hpf_WT")
)


```

```{r}
# run EISA

resWT_fixed <- runEISA(RexWT, RinWT, condWT_fixed)
resTent_fixed <- runEISA(RexTent, RinTent, condTent_fixed)
resNorm_fixed <- runEISA(RexNorm, RinNorm, condNorm_fixed)
```


```{r}
plotEISA(resWT_fixed)
```

```{r}
plotEISA(resNorm_fixed)
```

```{r}
plotEISA(resTent_fixed)
```

write.csv(resTent_fixed$tab.ExIn, file = "Hypoxia6hpftoHypoxia18hrsT42_eisadiff.csv")

#####  exon intron histograms


```{r}
# Combine all logFCs into one dataframe
df_combined <- data.frame(
  logFC = c(resNorm_fixed$tab.ExIn$logFC, resWT_fixed$tab.ExIn$logFC, resTent_fixed$tab.ExIn$logFC),
  group = factor(c(
    rep("6hpf to 8hpf", nrow(resNorm_fixed$tab.ExIn)),
    rep("6hpf to Hypoxia 18hrs WT", nrow(resWT_fixed$tab.ExIn)),
    rep("6hpf to Hypoxia 18hrs Tent5ba-42/-42", nrow(resTent_fixed$tab.ExIn))
  ))
)

# Kruskal-Wallis test
kruskal.test(logFC ~ group, data = df_combined)

```


```{r}

## plot histogram


p <- ggplot(
  df_combined,
  aes(x = logFC, fill = group, colour = group)
) +
  geom_density(
    alpha = 0.25,
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-7.5, 7.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#339900", "darkblue", "#66CCFF")
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("#339900", "darkblue", "#66CCFF")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Exon–Intron Changes Across Conditions",
    x = expression(Delta*log[2]*"FC (Exon – Intron)"),
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 28) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour= 'black', lindwidth = 0.8),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "intronexon_bygroup_new_fixed_updated_narrow_thin.tiff",
  plot = p,
  width = 15,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)

```

#### intron to exon ratios per gene and global


```{r}

group_levels <- c("Normoxia_6hpf_WT", "Normoxia_8hpf_WT",
                  "Hypoxia_18hrs_WT", "Hypoxia_18hrs_Tent5ba42")

group_colors <- c(
  "Normoxia_6hpf_WT"        = "#4DAF4A",
  "Normoxia_8hpf_WT"        = "darkgreen",
  "Hypoxia_18hrs_WT"        = "#377EB8",
  "Hypoxia_18hrs_Tent5ba42" = "#003366"
)

pseudocount <- 1

# Filter out genes that are all zeros in BOTH Rex and Rin across all samples


genes_with_data <- rowSums(Rex) > 0 | rowSums(Rin) > 0

Rex_filtered <- Rex[genes_with_data, ]
Rin_filtered <- Rin[genes_with_data, ]

cat("Genes retained:", sum(genes_with_data), "\n")
cat("Genes removed (all zeros):", sum(!genes_with_data), "\n\n")


# APPROACH 1: Global — sum(intron) / sum(exon) per sample


df_global <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(Rin_filtered),
  ratio  = (colSums(Rin_filtered) + pseudocount) / (colSums(Rex_filtered) + pseudocount)
) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(str_remove(sample, "_\\d+$"), levels = group_levels))


# APPROACH 2: Per-gene ratio — mean(intron/exon) across genes per sample


per_gene_ratio <- (Rin_filtered + pseudocount) / (Rex_filtered + pseudocount)

df_gene <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(Rin_filtered),
  ratio  = colMeans(per_gene_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(str_remove(sample, "_\\d+$"), levels = group_levels))


# Plot both side by side


df_global$method <- "Global: sum(Intron) / sum(Exon)"
df_gene$method   <- "Per-gene: mean(Intron / Exon)"

df_combined <- bind_rows(df_global, df_gene) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(method, levels = c(
    "Global: sum(Intron) / sum(Exon)",
    "Per-gene: mean(Intron / Exon)"
  )))

p <- ggplot(df_combined, aes(x = group, y = ratio, fill = group, color = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6, width = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = group_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title    = "Intron/Exon Ratio by Condition",
    subtitle = paste0("Each dot = one sample (pseudocount = ", pseudocount, 
                      ", genes with any data: ", sum(genes_with_data), ")"),
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Intron/Exon ratio"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text             = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black"),
    legend.position  = "none"
  )

print(p)
ggsave("intron_exon_ratio_two_methods.png", p, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```


```{r}
write.csv(df_combined, 'exonintronratios.csv')
```
